body: Status 2026-10-09: design records only. Open PRs: #708 (ADR-0040), #711 (ADR-0041), #712 (ADR-0042), #713 (ADR-0015/0016/MCP), #714 (migration claims). - `mcp`: `npm ci && npm test`: 32 pass, 0 fail (includes the medication exposure test).
- Vale full corpus: 25 findings, 0 new. `mkdocs build --strict`: exit 0.
- `run-tests.sh all`: SUITE PASSED on 16.15 (9m34s) and 15.19 (9m39s). pgTAP: 22 files, 259 tests. PHPUnit: 31 invocations, 1,996 tests, 15,933 assertions.
